<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the dominant ion appears at m/z 193.1103. Assuming this is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral mass is approximately 192.103 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass with common C/H/O composition is C₁₂H₁₆O₂. Therefore, the molecular formula of the sample is C12H16O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O2</final_answer>
